channel.title: pacs008 — ISO 20022 pacs.008 toolkit
channel.description: Updates from the pacs008 suite: the ISO 20022 pacs.008 core library, the MT103 migration loader, and the MCP server.

item.title: The pacs008 suite is live on PyPI
item.description: pacs008 v0.0.8, pacs008-loader-mt103 v0.0.3 and pacs008-mcp v0.0.6 are published, typed (py.typed) and Apache-2.0 licensed. Generate, validate and audit ISO 20022 pacs.008 across CBPR+, HVPS+, Fedwire, CHAPS, T2 and SCT Inst.
